body.summary: Nadia Pell (Photography) reports that the Ashmere VPN connects on her laptop in the office and the photo archive opens, but at home the same laptop stops at contacting gateway with no other error text. She needs the photo archive before the Friday night photo close. Current fields show category Network, priority High, status In Progress, and an empty resolution note. Activity records the ticket opening, a status change from New to In Progress, and an internal note confirming the office VPN connection and photo archive access and the same home stop at contacting gateway with no further error text. Nothing in the ticket says the issue has been fixed.
body.draft:
Hello Nadia,

We are working on the Ashmere VPN issue on your laptop. It connects in the office and the photo archive opens, but at home it stops at contacting gateway with no other error text. We have noted that you need the photo archive before the Friday night photo close. We will update you as we learn more.

Ashmere Press IT

body.summary: Tomas Reed (Bindery) reports that printer PR-4 in the bindery stops with panel code 41.2. He restarted the printer once before opening the ticket. Status is In Progress and the resolution note is empty. An internal note says 41.2 is a paper jam sensor, the network cable was reseated and is seated, Tomas and the technician found no paper in the path, and the panel still shows 41.2. Nothing in the ticket says the printer has been repaired or returned to service.
body.draft:
Hello Tomas,

Printer PR-4 in the bindery is still showing panel code 41.2 after the restart you did. The paper path was checked and no paper was found, and the network cable was reseated and is seated. The code is still on the panel, so this is not resolved yet.

Ashmere Press IT

body.summary: June Okonkwo (Design) reported that monitor MN-19 on her desk flickered whenever the cover layout was open. An internal note records that MN-19 was replaced with spare MN-44; the old monitor flickered within a minute and the spare did not. A saved reply from June says she used MN-44 for 20 minutes on the cover layout and the flicker was gone. Status is Resolved, and the resolution note records the same replacement and a 20-minute cover-layout check with no flicker.
body.draft:
Hi June,

Thanks for confirming that spare monitor MN-44 ran the cover layout for 20 minutes with no flicker after MN-19 was replaced. This ticket is marked Resolved based on that check.

Ashmere Press IT
